name: Water Jug
description: With additional hidden compartments, this small but mighty container can hold a lot more than you'd think. It is compact enough to keep the water's temperature optimal for consumption by plants, creatures and Cryptonauts alike.

name: Moon Strawberry
description: Covered in pinks and yellows, this moon berry decorates the bushes near the bare trees. Cryptonauts find them just as tasty as they look.

name: Moon Raspberry
description: An aquamarine berry that grows on the bushes by the craters. The name “Nature's Candy” does not do this extremely sweet fruit justice.

name: Moon Pear
description: This pear may not be as bright as its fruity counterparts; however, it is nutrient dense and offers essential vitamins. It can be found on the Spreading tree forms of the moon.

name: Moon Apple
description: Found on the lush Pyramidal tree forms of the moon, the Moon Apple is a vibrant fruit that offers a quick boost of energy. If what they say about an apple being more effective than a cup of coffee is true, then the Moon Apple is more effective than three.

name: Purple Moon Fish
description: The purple moon fish found in lakes has green fins and spots. These tiny accents provide a saltier taste, regardless of the usual sweetness of lake fish.

name: Pink Moon Fish
description: The Pink Moon Fish, also found in lakes, is the highest source of Energy. It is much sweeter than the purple, due to its yellow fins and neon trimmings.

name: Special Moon Berry
description: This berry can be spotted near the outer edges of the lakes and is specifically for the Moon Creatures. They favor the bitterness of the yellow seeds in this magical fruit.

name: Special Moon Fish
description: A sweet and salty fish, only found in rivers. River fish is for Moon Creatures in particular, as they enjoy the unusual, acquired taste of it.

name: Special Moon Plant
description: Flowering up the walls of the caves, the Special Moon Plant is for the Moon Creatures and offers them the highest source of Special Energy. The plant is so vibrant and beautiful that it is no surprise it holds poisonous qualities, but not for the Moon Creatures. They have a unique digestive system that can kill any harmful ingredients and convert it to Special Energy.

name: Moon Strawberry Seed
description: This heart-shaped kernel has the potential to grow a plant that will produce up to five quarts of Moon Strawberries a season. Pretty impressive for the moon's smallest seed.

name: Moon Raspberry Seed
description: With a watermelon-like appearance, the Moon Raspberry Seed produces the moon's sweetest fruit. The seeds themselves can be enjoyed, but it is only for those with a serious sweet tooth. Wow, a seed sweeter than candy…only on the moon!

name: Moon Pear Seed
description: This seed may produce the most nutrient-dense fruit in the universe; however, the seed itself is poisonous and extremely harmful to all living things. This is why this pretty little thing must be handled with caution.

name: Moon Apple Seed
description: It's hard to tell that this tiny seed will eventually grow into a stunning Pyramidal tree. The bright red shell hides its potential, but eventually, its stunning blue soul sprouts through and flourishes.

name: Special Moon Berry Seed
description: Looking like a rare gem, the Special Moon Berry Seed offers the pungent taste of a typical berry and a smell like no other. Its distinct odour can only be tamed with salt.

name: Special Moon Plant Seed
description: This is not like any other seed. This seed brings its planter good luck. Legend has it that the universe rewards those who take care of the ecosystem and since this plant offers the most nourishment to the creatures, the planter reaps what they sow in more ways than one.

name: Fishing Rod
description: Top of the line rod with an easy to use hook for bait. Get ready to reel in the biggest and finest catches!

name: Water Can
description: Offering water to the Moon and Special Moon Seeds in the Greenhouses, this can holds a lot more than it would seem. Made with a special absorbent material found on the moon's surface, this can is able to hold double its storage area, without affecting the water's quality and cleanliness.

name: Shovel
description: Designed with a nose of two meeting 45-degree angles, this shovel will skilfully pick up the remains of the pick's job. Get ready to dig deep with this handy tool.

name: Mining Pick
description: Sharper than a great white's teeth, this pick can puncture through any type of rock or surface on the moon.

name: Axe
description: This rare tool allows for the clearing of forest space on Moon Plots to make way for Moon Infrastructures. This hatchet is state-of-the-art and is able to chop down any tree, no matter its density.

name: Portable Oxygen Tank
description: The Portable Oxygen Tank helps Cryptonauts to travel across to the Dark Side of the Moon, regardless of atmospheric conditions. This tiny capsule holds volumes of compressed gas and will last for hours as Cryptonauts make the most of their time there. The use of space aluminium as its main material makes it lightweight and portable for those longer journeys.

name: Oxygen Tank
description: This tank is designed to help Cryptonauts learn to increase their natural oxygen levels, so that they are ready to make the venture to the other side of the moon. Its purpose is for use within the Oxygen Centres.

name: Food Box
description: Made with extremely durable material- space foam and plastic, this Food Box is designed for transporting food of any temperature. It's sleek, solid and impermeable to prevent any messes on the moon.

name: Special Food Box
description: The Moon Creatures require Special Food and Special Food requires a Special Box. This trusty capsule is far from your mom's Tupperware, as it's specifically engineered to maintain the food's rare, holistic qualities.

name: Wheelbarrow
description: Designed with an even weight distribution, this Wheelbarrow is just as easy to manoeuvre when filled to the brim with Gas, as when empty. The use of a lightweight space plastic also contributes to this wonderbarrow's effectiveness.

name: Mining Cart
description: This fancy, advanced wagon transports the Lithium Moon Rocks. It is small enough to take up the mountains and large enough to hold a substantial amount of the special metal.

name: Special Basket
description: The Special Basket is used to transport the electrical mushrooms. It is made of a non-conductive material that will maintain the needed energy of its contents.

name: Special Gloves
description: These Special Gloves allow for the preservation of the fossil's natural state through the prevention of disintegration. Fossils are delicate and the more intact they are when reaching the Research Labs, the better, which is why these particular gloves are essential when it comes to handling them.

name: Special Bag
description: This rare bag is designed specifically to transport raw moon stones to the Oxygen Centres. The magic is safeguarded due to the bag's special material: space canvas. Space canvas appears much more solid than earth canvas but because of the space cotton and other synthetic fabrics, this bag resembles more of a jet pack, than common transportation gear.

name: Painting Equipment
description: What would the universe be without a little décor and style? Regardless of being black, white and grey, both the brush and ruler spread tasteful design all over the Cryptonaut's side of the moon.

name: Spade
description: This lightweight digger is the most efficient and convenient of the shovel family. Offering a strong grip, this tool makes any project a breeze.

name: Bucket and Trowel
description: Impressive masonry is in the details, which is why this duo is a go-to for all brick and stonework. Crafted with smooth metal and fine edges, the trowel and its other half are essential for any type of construction.

name: Powered Saw
description: With blades of steel, this tool can seriously slice. Regardless of its great force, ultimate control is part of the package and will be appreciated by all masters of saw.

name: Hammer Drill
description: Able to pierce through concrete, rock, or diamond- the Hammer Drill is a must have tool on the moon. Nails included!

name: Welding Equipment
description: The welding machine is designed to quickly fuse any materials together. Unlike the average equipment, engineered specially for metals, plastics and woods, the moon welding machine works on any material imaginable.

name: Tool Box
description: Every handy Cryptonaut's dream- this Tool Box holds all the necessities to build and fix nearly anything on the moon. Each tool has its own place in this all-encompassing set.

name: Moon Closet
description: The Moon Closet houses all necessary tools needed to build Moon Infrastructures.

name: Scissor Lift
description: Made to reach heights beyond the view from its base, the scissor lift is a quick way to get those hard to reach places and build vertical.

name: Forklift
description: This lightweight champion of a forklift can hold up to nearly 100,000 lbs! This is crucial when it comes to transporting material to build.

name: Backhoe
description: This rear actor is the ultimate excavating machine. Offering ultimate power and precision, this vehicle will be a necessity when it comes to construction, demolition, landscaping and breaking through the hardest services of the moon.

name: Cement Mixer
description: Producing enough concrete for a metropolitan oasis, this mixer has a motor wattage of 3000. Flawlessly incorporating water and mix in a short period of time, this machine produces the most effective, smoothest concrete.

name: Excavator
description: This tank-like crawler is ideal for the uneven terrain of the moon. Its compact look and use of hydraulic power offer stability on tricky surfaces.

name: Dump Truck
description: Crack proof and rust proof- this dump truck helps transport construction materials, waste and just about anything that needs to get from A to B safe and secured.

name: Wheeled Crane
description: The Wheeled Crane can lift up to 18 tons- that's about five Moon Elephants! This baby also has the ability to move a full 360 degrees offering complete range of motion.

name: Hydraulic crane
description: Due to its internal hydraulic system, this crane can hold up to 50 tons! In comparison to the solid Wheeled Crane, that is about 12 and a half Moon Elephants, which more than doubles its weight capability.

name: Hovercraft
description: With its sleek, aerodynamic design, the Hovercraft can pierce through the wind with its airfoil composition and low drag shape. It can be upgraded and modified to increase Speed, Acceleration, and Control.

name: HC Balanced Wheel
description: The HC Balanced Wheel is a wheel modification that offers greater Control of a Hovercraft, while increasing Speed and Acceleration. All in all, this is the most comprehensive modification offered.

name: HC Standard Wheel
description: The HC Standard Wheel modification is aimed towards increasing Control of the Hovercraft, but unfortunately increases Acceleration time. The grip on this wheel is also worth noting as the space leather is perfect for all terrain driving control.

name: HC Expert Wheel
description: The Expert Wheel modification is fully specialized to increase Control, but greatly diminishes the Acceleration. The square shape is the optimal design for maintaining control.

name: HC Trainee Spoiler
description: This spoiler modification is mainly for adding Speed to the Hovercraft. It minimally increases Control and Acceleration.

name: HC Dart Spoiler
description: The Dart Spoiler allows for more Speed than the Trainee, but in turn takes away from vehicle Control.

name: HC Rapid Spoiler
description: This spoiler modification is fully specialized towards increasing the Speed of a Hovercraft, which then has a major negative effect on the vehicle's Control.

name: HC Surge Booster
description: This modification both decreases time of Acceleration and increases Speed; however, its main purpose is to increase the vehicle's Acceleration capabilities.

name: HC Velocity Booster
description: This booster modification is geared towards increasing Acceleration, which negatively affects the Speed. It is a step above the Surge Booster in terms of acceleration.

name: HC Lightning Booster
description: The Lighting Booster modification is designed for increasing Acceleration, but has a negative effect on Speed. In terms of Acceleration, it is more suitable than Surge and Velocity.

name: Race Car
description: Vroom vroom. This vehicle can be upgraded/modified to increase Speed, Acceleration, and Control. The rear spoiler majorly reduces drag and provides more grip, even when approaching those crazy speeds. With a powerful engine and traction in the tires, this car is ready to run.

name: RC Balanced Wheel
description: The RC Balanced Wheel is a wheel modification that offers greater control of a Race Car, while increasing Speed and Acceleration. This is a trusty, well-rounded modification.

name: RC Standard Wheel
description: The RC Standard Wheel modification is aimed towards increasing Control of the Race Car, but increases Acceleration time. The grip is of the same material as the HC Standard Wheel, offering greater grip.

name: RC Expert Wheel
description: The Expert Wheel modification is fully specialized to increase Control, but greatly impacts the Acceleration. The similar square shape of the HC Expert Wheel contributes to Control.

name: RC Trainee Spoiler
description: This spoiler modification allows for greater Speed of the Car, but only increases control and acceleration capabilities minimally.

name: RC Dart Spoiler
description: The Dart Spoiler allows for greater speed than the Trainee but then takes away from vehicle control.

name: RC Rapid Spoiler
description: This spoiler modification is designed for increasing the Speed of a Race Car, which then has a negative effect on the vehicle's Control.

name: RC Grip Tires
description: This modification decreases time of Acceleration, and increases Speed but is to be added mainly to amplify Acceleration.

name: RC Clutch Tires
description: The RC Clutch Tires are geared towards increasing acceleration capabilities more than the Grip Tires do, which has a greater negative effect on the Speed.

name: RC Rush Tires
description: The RC Rush Tires are designed for greater Acceleration capabilities than the Clutch, but have an even greater negative effect on Speed.

name: Moon Ticket
description: The Moon ticket grants access to Concert Hall for exciting events and concerts. It's time to let the good times roll.

name: Special Access Card
description: The holder of this card is part of an exclusive club. Definitely an item worth having, if at least not for the mystery of it all.

name: Moon Scroll
description: The Moon Scroll is a rare item that gives its owner advantage on The Dark Side of The Moon. It contains the Moon Code, which represents the beginnings of the relationship between the Cryptonauts and Moon Babies. It is the gold standard of behaviour as one accepts the responsibility to live and grow on the moon.

name: Gas
description: This black sand is found in the caves and is essential to all operations of the moon. Its texture is strange- soft and moist, yet leaves no liquid on the skin. Scientists have studied the mineral but have yet to explain this unique quality. Its colour is deep and rich but never runs, even when mixed with water.

name: Straight Mushroom
description: This mushroom is fully charged and ready to expel its energy through Watts. Comparable to the strongest battery on earth, the Straight Mushroom is found deep in craters, lighting up the darkest corners.

name: Curved Mushroom
description: Powerful and pink, this electrical mushroom is found in craters and produces enough Watts to illuminate the entire Dark Side. Only problem is, Cryptonauts have not yet figured out how to utilize this shroom to its full potential and can only extract a certain amount of Watts. This mushroom produces the highest amount of Watts regardless of the Cryptonaut's limited knowledge of it.

name: Lithium Moon Rock
description: This special rock is found high up in the mountains. Though it is not common to see, it is easy to spot due to its neon green color. This rock produces Lithium, the alkali metal used for powering some of the most important Infrastructures on the moon.

name: Moon Fossil 1
description: With the skeleton of what appears to be an extinct bird-like Moon Creature, Moon Fossil 1 is found deep in the ground, just outside the forest areas. As each discovery allows for Cryptonauts to further connect the dots of the past.

name: Moon Fossil 2
description: Also found just outside of the forest area, Moon Fossil 2 looks like the remains of a type of water creature. Archaeologists have tried to understand how these fossils have ended up deep in the ground, away from water and speculate a lake where we now have land. This fossil reminds Cryptonauts of a time before them. What is now, was not always so.

name: Raw Moon Stone
description: The breath-taking Raw Moon Stone is found on the outer edges of the craters. These Stones produce magic and gift its finders with an aura that attracts great fortunes and incredible opportunities going forward.

name: Moon Stone
description: Once refined at the Oxygen Centers, a beautiful spectrum of purple to pink is revealed on the rock. The stunning stone produces the highest amount of magic for those who understand how to utilize it.

name: Moon Device
description: This device unlocks the greatest opportunities of the universe.
